label: 核苷酸供给 → 核酸结构 → 复制 → 表达 → 调控 → 损伤/肿瘤分子Gate

precedence.within_scope: This batch is the working Learning owner for M9 + G1-G5 on branch b-learning-upgrade.

learning_arc.question: 细胞怎样先制造核苷酸原料，再把它们组织成可保存、复制、表达和调控的信息系统；当DNA损伤不能正确处理、油门持续开启或刹车失活时，怎样进入肿瘤分子失控，并用分子技术识别这些变化？
causal_spine: M9 supplies the material layer: PRPP, purine/pyrimidine synthesis, deoxynucleotide/dTMP production and anti-metabolite choke points.
G1 changes the question from supply to information structure: nucleotide → directional nucleic-acid chain → DNA/RNA/chromatin/genome organization.
G2 asks how that DNA is copied faithfully under 5′→3′ constraints, including telomere and reverse-transcription exceptions.
G3 asks how selected information becomes RNA and protein through transcription, RNA processing, translation and protein maturation.
G4 asks when/where/how much those genes are expressed, from chromatin and operons to cis/trans control and RNA interference.

G5 closes the branch by asking how mutation/repair failure plus oncogene activation/tumor-suppressor loss breaks growth control, then how recombinant DNA/PCR/hybridization tools inspect or manipulate the altered system.
learning_arc.exit_reconstruction: 闭卷从PRPP/IMP/UMP讲到DNA/RNA结构、复制、转录翻译、表达调控，再用『损伤/突变 + 原癌油门 + 抑癌刹车』解释分子层肿瘤失控；最后说明PCR/杂交/重组DNA等工具各在检测或操作哪一层。

evidence: M9 canonical owner says G1-G5 later Recall nucleotide supply/blockade rather than relearn it.
G5 canonical prerequisites include G1-G4 and M9, and its next path is pathology tumor gate then organ-specific tumor applications.
D21 contains a full thyroid-cancer section (KP23-KP25) inside the same canonical Block; splitting the Block solely to preserve the old route would violate Block continuity.
D23 explicitly recalls D21, so moving D22/D23 ahead while delaying only D21 would create a new dependency inversion.
